## Description

A flat, non-motile star-shaped coenobium of 16 cells, one cell thick (~10 µm). The 11 marginal cells
each carry two short horns (*P. boryanum*, *P. duplex*), extensions of the wall with cytoplasm. Each
cycle releases a daughter colony formed by zoospores.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `pond` (weight 0.15), `puddle` (weight 0.15); 6 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

A colony whose 22 marginal horns are [body processes](../../mechanics/shape-changes.md#silhouettes-and-processes)
in its outline; it releases daughter colonies. Horn length and width estimated (~half the marginal
cell).
